<subject>Re: Hello guys</subject>
<body>
Antoine,

Thanks for reaching out and sharing the paper on healthcare management. I have reserved March the 2nd for the meeting to discuss the implications of the New Economy on our hospital group's operations. I am looking forward to exploring how we can adapt our business education programs to better serve the needs of our patients and staff.

I am also interested in participating in the workshop you are organizing on Friday, February 27th, to brainstorm about the new world of healthcare and its implications for our industry. Please keep me updated on the details and I will make sure to clear my schedule.

In the meantime, I have been reviewing the attached document, "risk_management_in_hospitals.pdf", and I think it raises some important points about risk assessment and mitigation in our field. I would like to discuss this further with you and explore ways to implement some of the strategies outlined in the paper.

Please let me know if this is something we can discuss further at the meeting or if you would like to schedule a separate call to talk about it.

Best regards,
Aimé Ruiz, Analyst
+33 4 72 34 56 78
Lumière Santé SAS
12 Rue de la République
69001 Lyon, France

</body>

Aimé and Stinson,

Just got a copy of the attached paper on healthcare management and thought it may have some interest for you guys.

On another note, I am putting together a workshop in the spring on the New Economy and Healthcare Education and will be seeking out some Lumière Santé network people to join in the discussion (2-hours on Friday February 27th).  I'll let you know more as we work through the details.  The idea is to "brainstorm" about the new world you guys work in every day and its implications for what we should be doing.  Hope this is interesting to you and that you'll want to spend the day with us.
